info.title: Aegis AI — Backend REST API
info.description:
Generated from the running Express router by `scripts/openapi.mjs`; the
route inventory is never hand-maintained. Prose lives in
`scripts/openapi.meta.mjs`.

Routes marked `x-documented: false` are served but not yet described.

Every route below is also reachable under `/api/*` without the version
segment. That alias is the legacy spelling of this same router, kept for
backward compatibility — not a second API.

This document is generated to a file and served nowhere. A complete route
inventory maps the attack surface.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes. Unauthenticated by necessity.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, sign-in, sessions, verification and recovery.

tags.name: Chat
tags.description: The customer-facing AI conversation, including the streaming path.

tags.name: Company
tags.description: Insurers — shared reference data across tenants.

tags.name: UI Action
tags.description: Structured actions the AI asks the interface to take.

tags.name: Enterprise Console
tags.description: Tenant administration. Read-heavy by design: it watches and reports, and decides nothing a person is answerable for.

tags.name: Employee Workspace
tags.description: The queue an employee works, realm-walled as a whole. A customer's session reaches none of it.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: The document platform. Scoped by caller rather than realm-walled — a customer legitimately manages their own documents.

tags.name: Intelligence
tags.description: A customer's insurance profile, the advice derived from it, and aggregate views for staff.

tags.name: Knowledge
tags.description: Approved guidance and institutional memory. Provenance is the point: advice traced to nothing is advice the business cannot defend.

tags.name: Platform
tags.description: Platform operation — tenants, licences, settings and sessions. The narrowest door on the API.

tags.name: Undocumented
tags.description: Served, but not yet described. A gap, shown rather than hidden.
